_note: FairPlay v3 coverage vectors (revision 2). Synthetic, structurally valid inputs; they check equivalence with the reference, not with Apple clients. cases: 16 per mode; cases 00-07 of each mode embed one of 8 coverage blocks as the round-1 sap_hash input (chosen by mutation testing so that every operation-level mistake that changes sap_hash output is caught); cases 08-15 are random. sap_hash_cases test sap_hash in isolation (b3 starts as 132 zero bytes). garble_trace gives the value written by each of the 173 garble operations for one input (bytes as 2 hex digits, scratch variables as 8).
